categories.main_business_segments: Mizuho Leasing operates three main business segments: (1) Lease & Installment Sales, which includes leasing and installment sales of real estate, industrial and construction machinery, IT equipment, transportation equipment, and environmental/energy-related facilities; (2) Finance, which covers lending, equity investments, and factoring for real estate, aircraft, ships, and environmental/energy sectors; and (3) Other, which includes used asset sales and power generation businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced financial structuring, risk management, and asset management expertise to deliver leasing, installment sales, and financing solutions. It utilizes digital transformation (DX), data analytics, and platform-based approaches to enhance operational efficiency and customer value, and applies asset lifecycle management and circular economy principles in its business models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Mizuho Leasing serves a broad range of corporate clients, from large enterprises to SMEs, across industries such as manufacturing, construction, logistics, real estate, healthcare, and energy. Its end markets include domestic Japanese corporations, overseas subsidiaries of Japanese companies, and global clients in sectors like aviation, shipping, and renewable energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: While the majority of business is concentrated in Japan, Mizuho Leasing has a significant international presence with subsidiaries and affiliates in Asia (China, Singapore, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam), Europe (UK), and North America. The company is expanding its global footprint, particularly in growth markets such as India and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Mizuho Leasing operates primarily in the downstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, providing end-user financing, asset leasing, and value-added solutions to corporate clients. It also engages in upstream activities through investments and partnerships in asset development and infrastructure projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on transforming its business portfolio by strengthening core areas (domestic leasing, real estate), expanding growth domains (global, aviation, environment/energy), and investing in frontier fields (circular economy, XaaS). Key initiatives include digital transformation, sustainability (decarbonization, circular economy), human capital development, and alliances with Mizuho Financial Group, Marubeni, and startups.
categories.revenue_model: Mizuho Leasing generates revenue primarily through lease payments, installment sales, interest income from loans, asset management fees, and sales of used assets. It also earns income from equity investments, power generation, and various financial services, with a mix of recurring and transactional revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese leasing companies such as ORIX, Mitsubishi HC Capital, and Sumitomo Mitsui Finance & Leasing. Mizuho Leasing is positioned as a top-tier, diversified financial services provider with strong backing from Mizuho Financial Group and Marubeni, and differentiates itself through its multi-solution platform and focus on sustainability and digital innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue reached ¥695.4 billion, with net income attributable to parent shareholders of ¥42.0 billion and total assets of ¥3.9 trillion. The company has demonstrated robust growth, achieving record profits and exceeding its mid-term plan targets ahead of schedule, driven by expansion in core and growth segments and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Mizuho Leasing emphasizes its role as a multi-solution platformer, offering comprehensive, flexible, and innovative financial solutions that go beyond traditional leasing. Its unique value lies in its ability to co-create value with clients, address social and environmental challenges, provide end-to-end asset lifecycle management, and leverage digital and sustainability initiatives to support clients’ business growth and transformation.
